name: SenseNova U1.6
notes: SenseTime's unified 8B MoT model: one checkpoint holds the image model and its own language model, which reads the prompt. It draws in pixels, so there is no VAE file.

With the 8-step LoRA at strength 1: 10 steps at cfg 1 (8 looks flat), 12 for sharper lines (anime). 50 steps at cfg 4 without the LoRA comes out very bright. euler / simple, no shift node (the model sets its own shift 3).
Trained at 2048 x 2048 (4 MP). Works from 1 to 16 MP, sides in multiples of 32, 1:3 to 3:1.
Edits: pictures go into HiDream-O1 Reference Images, then SenseNova Conditioning (task image) before the sampler.
bf16 only: fp16 overflows in the language model. Apache 2.0.
source: Hugging Face tree API sizes (Comfy-Org/SenseNova-U1), 2026-11-24; settings from the Comfy-Org templates image_sensenova_u16_t2i / image_edit
